events.text: Return to Home Quay to settle accounts.
Harvest feast: collect 15 from each player.
Harbormaster's favor: keep this pass to leave the Brig free.
A strong current carries you forward 4 spaces.
Dock refit: pay 40 per depot and 130 per port.
Audit failed. Go directly to the Brig.
Launch day: collect 30 from each player.
Hail the nearest ferry. If owned, pay double fare.
Stand the fleet a round: pay each player 40.
Drift to the nearest works. If owned, roll and pay 10 times the dice.
Fair winds carry you to Home Quay.
